exclusions: Columns where overlap obscures one trace excluded; this may upward-bias difference magnitude and is not the authors paired t-test effect estimate. Use only to support lower high-contrast trace, alongside reported t-test and TOST.
method: Native embedded 720x1213 RGB raster. Identify red low-contrast and blue high-contrast traces by RGB inequalities; median colored pixel per x; compare x=65..290 where both traces are visible. Vertical separation divided by the 1 ΔF/F scale bar (73 px).
plot_domain: position along depicted virtual translation; columns are not biological replicates
source_consistency: Main text p11 reports high-contrast attenuation; Fig3e visually agrees; caption p9 incorrectly states no amplitude effect. No silent correction of caption.

interpretation_limit: Approximate pooled mean trace only; SEM band not digitized. Does not establish statistical equivalence or exclude rapid voltage adaptation; positive sustained HS calcium contrasts with behavioral direction reversal.
method: PyMuPDF drawing index 880 is filled dark-blue highest-contrast HS mean trace. Sample cubic Bezier outline, intersect vertical scanlines and use outline midpoint. Estimate zero from prestimulus x=280..289; calibrate 0.5 ΔF/F bar y=368.0998..389.4988. Windows are defined relative to gray stimulus extent, not assumed seconds.
